 Pay-as-you go pricing for the WhatsApp Business API

Our transparent, scalable WhatsApp pricing makes it easy to understand how much you’ll pay to send WhatsApp messages from your business.

Start for free

Twilio WhatsApp pricing summary

  • Twilio’s message handling fee: $0.005 per message
  • Pay Meta’s template fees for Marketing, Utility, Authentication, Service messages
  • Utility and authentication messages start at $0.0034/message
Start for free
Pricing current as of September 2026

Jump to:        WhatsApp messaging        WhatsApp calling        FAQ

WhatsApp messaging pricing calculator

WhatsApp pricing is calculated based on Twilio’s per-message fee, plus Meta’s per-template message fee, which Twilio passes through to customers. Twilio’s per-message fee for WhatsApp is $0.005, inbound or outbound*. Meta’s per-template message fees are available on WhatsApp’s rate cards.

How Meta's template fees and categories work

The Meta per-template message fee varies by use case: utility, authentication, marketing or service. You are charged for each template or non-template message you send.

During a customer service window, Meta charges for utility template messages and non-template outbound service messages.

A customer service window lasts for 24 hours after you receive a customer-initiated WhatsApp message.

Utility Template
Specific customer requests, transactions, post-purchase notifications, or billing reminders.

Authentication Template
**One-time passcodes.

See Verify WhatsApp pricing

Marketing Template
Business-initiated template that does not qualify as utility or authentication (e.g. promotions, offers, informational updates, survey requests).

Service Messages
***Non-template messages that are sent during a customer service window.

WhatsApp Business Calling pricing

WhatsApp Business Calling uses per-minute pricing. It’s calculated based on Twilio’s channel API fee, plus Meta’s WhatsApp Connectivity fee, which Twilio passes through to customers.

Get started with WhatsApp messaging for free

Integrate with Twilio’s powerful APIs to start connecting with your customers on WhatsApp. Start building for free today.

Start for free Contact sales

Learn more about WhatsApp pricing

Twilio WhatsApp messaging pricing combines Twilio's per-message platform fee with Meta's per-template conversation fee. Twilio charges $0.005 per message inbound or outbound, while Meta fees vary by message category and destination country.

Meta charges per-template message fees that vary depending on the message category (marketing, utility, or authentication) and the destination country. Twilio passes Meta per-template message fees directly through to customers.

Yes. Utility template messages do not incur Meta per-template fees when sent within an open customer service window. Twilio's standard per-message fee of $0.005 still applies.

Yes. You can sign up for a free trial to start building and testing without entering a credit card, then transition to a paid plan and with usage-baed pricing as you scale.
